scenes.title: Platform 4, 11:47 PM
narration: Baarish ki boondein platform 4 ki tin shed par tabla baja rahi hain. Announcement goonjti hai — 'Yatri kripya dhyaan dein... aakhri local...'
Tum daud ke coach mein chadhte ho. Saamne wali seat par ek ladki book padh rahi hai — cover par likha hai 'The Hound of the Baskervilles'. Wo nazar utha ke dekhti hai.
'First time last local mein?' wo poochti hai, 'Main Aarohi. Aur haan — wo kone wali seat mat lena. Legend hai.'
fallbackLines: Train chalne wali hai. Aarohi tumhe dekh rahi hai — kuch faisla karo. Baithoge kahan?
Announcement dobara goonjti hai. Tumhare paas zyada time nahi — train chalne hi wali hai!

Legend wali kone ki seat par baithta/baithti hoon

scenes.title: Aakhri Local
narration: Train jhatke ke saath chalti hai. Coach mein sirf kuch log — ek budhiya aunty jo khidki se baahar dekh ke muskura rahi hain, aur gate par khada TC jo sabko ghoor raha hai.
Aarohi dheere se kehti hai — 'Wo dekho, white saree wali aunty. Har Friday dikhti hain... aur Dadar se pehle gayab ho jaati hain. 8:47 wali spirit aunty.'
Tumhare pair ke paas kuch takrata hai — seat ke neeche ek purana STEEL DABBA rakha hai. Laawaris.
fallbackLines: Steel dabba wahi pada hai. Aarohi tumhe dekh rahi hai — 'Khol ke dekhein?' uski aankhon mein shararat hai.
TC Rathore abhi doosre coach mein gaya hai. Dabba kholne ka yehi mauka hai... ya usse door raho?

choices.text: Steel dabba khol ke dekhta/dekhti hoon

memory: User ne laawaris steel dabba khola.

choices.text: TC Rathore ko laawaris dabbe ke baare mein batata/batati hoon
White saree wali aunty se baat karta/karti hoon

scenes.title: Tunnel Mein Andhera
narration: KHADDD! Train ek jhatke se rukti hai. Bahar ghup andhera — Andheri tunnel. Lights ek baar... do baar... teen baar flicker karke bujh jaati hain. Sirf emergency lamp jal rahi hai.
Speaker par motorman ki ghabrayi awaaz — 'Y-yatri dhyaan dein... signal failure hai... ghabrane ka nahi... Rathore sahab dekh rahe hain...'
Aunty dheere se kehti hain — 'Mera Francis kehta tha... train kabhi bina wajah nahi rukti, baba.' Aur tabhi — luggage rack par kuch HILTA hai!
fallbackLines: Andhera gehra hai. Luggage rack par movement hui thi — koi hai wahan? Torch nahi hai, par phone ki flashlight hai.
Rathore torch leke aa rahe hain. Usse pehle tum kya karoge — chhupoge, chillaaoge, ya khud check karoge?

choices.text: Phone ki flashlight jala ke rack ki taraf dekhta/dekhti hoon

memory: User ne flashlight se luggage rack check kiya.

choices.text: Darr rahi aunty ko sambhalta/sambhalti hoon

scenes.title: Dabbe Ka Raaz
narration: Dhakkan khulta hai — andar paise ya gehne nahi... ek purana LIFAAFA, kuch black-and-white photos, aur ek railway badge. Photos mein ek young motorman, aur uske saath... yehi white-saree wali aunty, jawaan!
Aarohi photos dekhti hai — 'Ye to aunty hain! Matlab ye dabba... unka hai?' Tabhi TRAIN RUKTI HAI. Tunnel. Andhera. Emergency lamp.
Rathore torch leke aata hai — 'Ye dabba kiske paas tha?! Pichhle 2 mahine mein 6 dabbe gayab hue hain is line se!'
fallbackLines: Rathore ka torch tumhare chehre par hai. Dabba tumhare haath mein. Ab sach bolo — ya Aarohi ko bolne do?
Aunty dheere se uth rahi hain... unki nazar dabbe par hai. Shayad ye unka hi hai.

choices.text: Sach bolta/bolti hoon — dabba seat ke neeche mila tha
Dabba aunty ko de deta/deti hoon — 'Ye aapka hai na?'

scenes.title: Rack Par Kaun?
narration: Roshni padte hi rack se ek LADKA koodta hai — 15-16 saal ka, haath mein ek chhota steel dabba! 'RUK!' Rathore dahadta hai, par ladka gate ki taraf bhaagta hai.
Aarohi chillati hai — 'Uske haath mein dabba hai! Yehi hai chor!' Ladka fisal ke girta hai — dabba chhoot ke tumhare pairon ke paas aa girta hai.
Wo minminata hai — 'M-mereko jaane do... Bhai maar dalega... please...'
fallbackLines: Ladka tumhare saamne gira pada hai. Rathore paas aa raha hai. Tum faisla karo — usse pakadoge, ya uski baat sunoge?
'Bhai maar dalega' — ye Bhai kaun hai? Ladka sach mein dara hua lag raha hai.

choices.text: Ladke ko pakad ke Rathore ke hawale karta/karti hoon
'Ruko! Pehle iski baat sunte hain' — ladke ko mauka deta/deti hoon

memory: User ne Chintu ki baat suni — wo gang ke dabaav mein chori karta hai.

scenes.title: Francis Ka Letter
narration: Aunty kaanpte haathon se lifaafa leti hain. 'Francis ke jaane ke baad likha tha... 12 saal se himmat nahi hui post karne ki. Aaj uski barsi hai — main ye letter uski favourite jagah... Dadar ke purane signal ke paas... rakhne jaa rahi thi.'
Tabhi rack se AWAAZ — ek ladka kood ke bhaagta hai! Rathore chillata hai — 'CHOR! PAKDO!' Aur aunty ka letter hawa mein ud ke... tumhare haath mein aa jaata hai.
Ek taraf bhaagta chor. Doosri taraf aunty ka toota dil. Kya karoge?
fallbackLines: Letter tumhare haath mein hai, chor bhaag raha hai. Dono kaam zaroori hain — pehle kya?
Aarohi already chor ke peeche badh rahi hai! Tum letter sambhalo ya uska saath do?

choices.text: Letter sambhal ke aunty ko deta/deti hoon, Aarohi chor ke peeche
Aarohi ke saath chor ke peeche daudta/daudti hoon

scenes.title: Sach Saamne Aata Hai
narration: Rathore ne ladke — Chintu — ko pakad liya hai. Wo ro raha hai: 'Bhai ne kaha tha... ek dabba laa... nahi to station se bhaga dega... mujhe nahi pata tha ismein letter hain!'

Aunty aage aati hain. Sabko laga daantegi — par wo Chintu ke sar par haath rakhti hain. 'Francis kehta tha... bhookha bachcha chor nahi hota, majboor hota hai. Beta, aaj se tu mere saath khana khayega.'
Speaker par awaaz — 'Signal clear! Train chalne wali hai!' Sab hanste hain. Aur tum? Tumhe faisla karna hai — ye raat kaise khatm hogi.
fallbackLines: Train chalne wali hai. Chintu ro raha hai, aunty muskura rahi hain, Rathore report likh raha hai. Tumhari aakhri chaal?
Ye raat tumhe yaad rahegi. Bas ek aakhri faisla baaki hai.

choices.text: Rathore ke saath Bhai ke godown ka pata batata/batati hoon (Chintu ne bataya)
Aunty ke saath Dadar utar ke letter rakhne jaata/jaati hoon
Chintu ko vada pav khilata/khilati hoon — 'Ab se tu hamari detective team mein!'

scenes.title: Ending: Platform Ke Hero
narration: Agle din newspaper mein chhoti si khabar — 'Dadar godown se 6 chori ke dabbe baramad, ek giraftar.' Rathore tumhe phone karta hai — 'Beta, Bhai pakda gaya. Chintu ab station ki canteen mein kaam karta hai. Aur haan — agli baar ticket lena mat bhoolna!'
Aarohi message karti hai — 'Detective sahab/sahiba, agla case: hamari building ka missing paani-meter. Are you in?'
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

scenes.title: Ending: Francis Tak Pahunchi Chitthi
narration: Dadar ke purane signal ke paas, aunty letter rakh ke aasmaan ki taraf dekhti hain. 'Pahunch gayi, Francis.' Unki aankhon mein aansu bhi hain, sukoon bhi.

Wo tumhara haath pakadti hain — 'Aaj se har Friday, tu mere saath last local mein aayega/aayegi. Banana chips main laaungi.' Aarohi dheere se kehti hai — 'Legend solved. Spirit aunty... sabse sweet aunty nikli.'
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

scenes.title: Ending: Detective Team 11:47
narration: Station ke bahar tapri par — tum, Aarohi, Chintu aur cutting chai. 'Team ka naam?' Chintu poochta hai. 'DETECTIVE TEAM 11:47!' sab chillate hain. Rathore door se dekh ke muskurata hai.
Aunty apna dabba leke ghar chali jaati hain — par jaane se pehle Chintu ko ek banana chips ka packet deti hain. 'Khaana kha ke aana, beta.' Last local phir kabhi itni sunsaan nahi lagegi.
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!
